messages:
rachel_sales: Quick one 00NimbusFinance is blocking on procurement. They want a tight POC pack: SOC2 excerpts for encryption + access control, a pen-test attestation (they prefer signed), short dependency list, and a Dedicated+VPC pricing delta. Need by Fri COB.
diego_se: I can pull SOC2 excerpts and a network sketch. Do we have a signed pen-test attestation for POCs or just a template?
nina_security: We generally provide an unsigned template and can escalate for a signed vendor attestation. Legal signs vendor letters; external attestor adds ~7 business days. I'll add a dependency matrix (top OSS libs + patch cadence).
ops_maya: Pricing delta depends on reserved GPUs and isolation. If they need tenant isolation + UK residency, that adds a commit multiplier and network egress fees. Ask them for sustained RPS and peak.
rachel_sales: They said ~30 rps sustained, average 1.2k tokens, spikes to 150 rps. UK residency is preferred but eu-west acceptable if delta >20%.
diego_se: OK will assemble bundle: SOC2 excerpt PDF, network diagram, pen-test template (marked sample), KMS options note.
nina_security: Add signatory note: "Signed attestation requires Legal approval (3-5bd) or external attestor (~7bd)." Also include scan rules: 72h window, approved IP list.
ops_maya: I'll draft a short pricing table (hosted vs dedicated-shared vs dedicated-isolated UK) with assumptions. Posting numbers in thread shortly.
legal_assist: Noted. If customer insists on vendor-signed letter for procurement, route to legal@redwood and allow 3 working days.
rachel_sales: Action items: Diego upload bundle by Thu EOD, Nina add dependency matrix + signatory text, Maya post pricing delta. I'll confirm with NimbusFinance whether they require an active scan. :thumbsup:
diego_se: Will upload by Thu 17:00.
rachel_sales: Thanks team — if they don't require an external scan we can hit Fri COB. If they do, we'll push the date out. :rocket:
